sql_templates.sql_text:
WITH latest_breadth AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM breadth.sector_daily
    WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM breadth.sector_daily)
),
latest_stage AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM scores.stage_snapshots
    WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
        AND stage = 'STAGE_2'
)
SELECT lb.sector, lb.breadth_signal, ls.symbol, ls.trading_signal
FROM latest_breadth lb
JOIN latest_stage ls ON lb.sector = ls.sector
ORDER BY lb.breadth_signal DESC
LIMIT 10;

sql_templates.name: latest_insider_bulk_deals
sql_templates.template:
WITH latest_insider_alerts AS (SELECT symbol, MAX(alert_date) AS max_alert_date FROM signals.insider_alerts GROUP BY symbol),
latest_bulk_deals AS (SELECT symbol, MAX(deal_date) AS max_deal_date FROM signals.bulk_block_deals GROUP BY symbol) 
SELECT ia.symbol, ia.alert_type, ia.qty, ia.value_cr, bd.side, bd.qty AS deal_qty, bd.price, ss.technical_score 
FROM signals.insider_alerts ia 
JOIN latest_insider_alerts lia ON ia.symbol = lia.symbol AND ia.alert_date = lia.max_alert_date 
JOIN signals.bulk_block_deals bd ON ia.symbol = bd.symbol 
JOIN latest_bulk_deals lbd ON bd.symbol = lbd.symbol AND bd.deal_date = lbd.max_deal_date 
JOIN scores.stage_snapshots ss ON ia.symbol = ss.symbol 
WHERE ss.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots) 
AND ss.trading_signal IN ('BUY', 'STRONG_BUY') 
LIMIT 10;
